_: The App Store panels on #apps. One entry per panel: a Higgsfield plate from static/img/plates/ as the scene, the real rendered app screen from static/img/suite/ inside a phone drawn in CSS, and a headline set in the site's own type. Nothing here is generated text or generated interface — the model only ever draws the ROOM. scripts/panels.mjs turns this into static/img/panels/<id>.webp.
